parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The namespace. This parameter takes effect only when both the namespace and the service account are specified. Otherwise, it is ignored.

parameters.name: ServiceAccount
parameters.description: The service account. This parameter takes effect only when both the namespace and the service account are specified. Otherwise, it is ignored.

parameters.name: ServiceMeshId
parameters.description: The ID of the Service Mesh (ASM) instance.

parameters.name: TrustDomain
parameters.description: The trust domain. If both the namespace and the service account are specified, the default value is cluster.local. Otherwise, this parameter is ignored.
